title: TRUTH (The Eighth Discipline)
style:
```
raw electronic rock, direct unflinching male vocal NZ/AU accent, no vocal effects no pitch correction, honest production that doesn't hide behind complexity, sparse and real, breath audible, silence as punctuation, [PERSONA_NAME] voice, V4_5ALL, 108 BPM
```

lyrics:
``
[VERSE 1]
Satya — non-violence starts with truth
